summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Clara Dashboard new features: Grouped navigation menu, Personal Settings page, and Admin user switching. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Grouped navigation correctly organizes items into Shows, Content, Communication, Administration categories
Personal Settings page at /settings shows profile info and navigation display toggle
Flat menu view shows icon-only navigation when grouped_menu is false
POST /api/admin/switch-user/{user_id} creates token for target user with original_user info
TeamSettingsPage shows 'Login as User' option in user dropdown for non-current users
Impersonation banner shows at top with 'Return to [admin]' button
Non-admin users correctly blocked from switch-user endpoint (403)
seed_data_creation: Created test user (testuser@radio.com) for user switching tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clara Dashboard features fully tested. New endpoints: PUT /api/users/me/preferences, GET /api/users/me/preferences, POST /api/admin/switch-user/{user_id}, POST /api/admin/exit-impersonation. Frontend: PersonalSettingsPage.js at /settings, DashboardLayout.js has grouped/flat navigation toggle, TeamSettingsPage.js has 'Login as User' dropdown option. Test user created: testuser@radio.com (editor role).

flat_navigation.details: Sidebar shows icon-only flat navigation (72px width) when grouped_menu=false

personal_settings_page.details: /settings route shows profile section and navigation display toggle with preview

user_preference_save.details: PUT /api/users/me/preferences saves grouped_menu preference to database

user_preference_load.details: GET /api/auth/me returns preferences field with grouped_menu value

admin_switch_user.details: POST /api/admin/switch-user/{user_id} creates token for target user with original_user info

admin_exit_impersonation.details: POST /api/admin/exit-impersonation returns to admin account with new token

impersonation_banner.details: Orange banner shows 'Viewing as [user]' with 'Return to [admin]' button

login_as_user_dropdown.details: TeamSettingsPage shows 'Login as User' option in edit dropdown for non-current users

non_admin_blocked.details: Non-admin users receive 403 when trying to use switch-user endpoint
